#3954. Compare the two DXC panes, not the source.

dxc 1.6.2112 does not compile this at all: its pane has no DXIL and an abnormal exit
status. CE runs Linux release builds, which report it as a terminating signal with no
diagnostic text. On Windows the same release version prints two lines naming the failing
lowering pass and its source line; the class of failure is the same, and the wording is
not portable between the two.

dxc trunk compiles the same source and emits DXIL. Look for the entry point's single
CBufferLoadLegacy, one extractvalue, and three fmul instructions against that one
component -- the correct lowering of an expression the older pane could not lower.

Nothing in this banner should be searched for in the panes below: CE compiles it as part
of the source, so DXC embeds it verbatim in the trunk pane debug metadata.
